forcing_interpretation: A 100 mm shallow-water-table boundary was imposed while the field was under the reconstructed flood. This represents the reported lower bound of mean water depth, not APSIM surface ponding.
weather: NASA POWER 0.5 x 0.625 degree daily grid at the reported site coordinate; the four-day event pattern was scaled to the published 185.60 mm total.
soil: ISRIC SoilGrids support point 33.60N, 113.80E because the exact site coordinate returned null. Sand, silt, clay, bulk density, organic carbon and -33/-1500 kPa water contents were used; hydraulic conductivity remained a 25/75/200 mm/day scenario range.

crop.proxy_warning: The paper does not provide APSIM parameters, sowing date or row spacing. APSIM DeKalb models are used only as two process proxies and are not identified as the real varieties.

extraction_caveats: The extraction CSV has no cultivar column for Table 2 yield components.
The extraction CSV repeats the two CK rows because cultivar identity was lost.
Yield means and treatment contrasts were manually cross-checked against Table 2 and the text.
Plot replication count and error-bar definition are not reported.
